settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.content:
Q: What if my dog doesn't like the chews?
A: In the rare case that this happens, we’ll send you a replacement flavour for free. If your dog doesn’t like that one either, we’ll issue a full refund.

Q: How long until I start seeing the benefits?
A: Most dog owners notice improvements within 4–6 weeks, such as less paw licking, reduced scratching, or better digestion.

For full benefits like healthier skin, a shinier coat, and more energy, give the chews for at least 6 to 8 weeks. Consistency is key!

Q: At what age can my dog start using these?
A: Our chews are suitable for dogs of all ages and breeds. We recommend introducing it into your dog’s daily routine starting from 3 months of age.

settings.title: What if my dog doesn’t like the chews?
settings.content:
In the rare case that this happens, we’ll send you a replacement flavour (chicken or beef) for free.

If your dog doesn’t like that one either, we’ll issue a full refund—no problem.

settings.title: At what age can my pup start using these?
settings.content: The Multivitamin is suitable for dogs of all ages and breeds. However, we do recommend dogs begin to incorporate the chews into their daily routine starting at an age of 3 months or older.

settings.title: What does 100% Human-Grade mean?
settings.content: Most pet supplements from other brands contain palm oil, fillers, artificial flavoring, preservatives, etc. At VitalPaws, we’re raising the standards of pet health by only using the highest quality human-grade ingredients, which is what our best friends deserve.

settings.title: How long until I start seeing the benefits?
settings.content: The benefits that most dogs feel—less itching, more activity, better mood—are just bonuses to improving their long-term health. If taken consistently on a daily basis, most dogs will start to see positive effects in about 6-8 weeks.

settings.title: How many chews come in a jar?
settings.content:
There are 60 Chews in each jar, which is a 2-month supply for Small Dogs (0-12kg / 0-26lbs).
Medium dogs (12-34kg / 26-75lbs) will need a monthly frequency.
Bigger dogs (34kg / 75lbs +) will need a 3-weekly frequency.

settings.title: What flavour is the Multivitamin?
settings.content: Our Multivitamin is made with the highest quality human-grade chicken liver, a flavor that dogs absolutely love. In the case of a chicken allergy, we recommend our Beef flavour!

settings.title: What happens if I accidentally give my dog too many chews?
settings.content: In the event that your dog accidentally consumes significantly more than the daily recommended dose, consult your vet for advice.

settings.title: Can I take this dog multivitamin with other supplements?
settings.content: Our veterinary team formulated our Daily Vitamin with natural ingredients that can be taken both alone or as a complementary product with other common and more targeted pet supplements. Nevertheless, we still recommend checking with your vet.
